summary: Iteration 2 — regression + async-notes verification after dark cosmic redesign. Backend: 29/29 pytest pass (auth admin/teacher/student + me/dup/invalid/no-token, batches CRUD/RBAC/join, ASYNC notes create→poll→ready with sections+image_paths+coverage.total_points>0, notes list has status field, timed test end-to-end incl. answer-hiding for students & preview for teacher & double-submit block, DPP repeatable, stats for all roles). POST /api/notes returned in <1s with {status:'processing'}; polling GET /api/notes/{id} reached status='ready' with 4+ sections, images, and coverage.total_points=12. Frontend: teacher/admin/student logins all pass on /auth (Log in button, data-testid=auth-submit). NoteReader for the pre-seeded ready note 97fb471e… renders full content with 4 images and 18 formula/mono chips. Full async UI flow: teacher fills Title/Class/Subject/Chapter/rough-text → Generate → instantly navigates to /notes/:id showing the animated 'Crafting your beautiful notes' loader with 'Reading your source material…' substatus and a 'Generating your notes — hang tight!' toast; the notes library concurrently shows a GENERATING badge on the new card; after ~80s the reader auto-renders the finished note with intro, numbered sections, concept illustrations. Dark cosmic theme renders correctly across auth, dashboard, create-note, library, and reader — light text on dark surfaces, readable contrast, no white/broken layouts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 714 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting notes/tests/auth into separate modules.

asyncio.create_task(_process_note) is fire-and-forget; if the ASGI worker restarts mid-generation, notes are stuck in 'processing' forever with no recovery/timeout. Consider a startup sweep that marks stale processing notes as failed, or a real background worker.
GenerateTestInput.kind still accepts any free string (repeat from iteration 1).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ teacher/student per pytest run, plus one UI-facing 'UI TEST Async Motion Notes' note under teacher@vidya.com in Class 9 / Science / Matter in Our Surroundings (reached status=ready). Pre-seeded ready note 97fb471e-7256-4992-ac5c-163dc98f6547 was used only for read verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py test_20 now uses the ASYNC pattern (POST returns instantly with status='processing', then polls GET /api/notes/{id} up to 200s until status='ready') and asserts coverage.total_points>0 plus at least one image_path. test_21 asserts every /api/notes list item exposes a 'status' field. All other tests unchanged from iteration 1. Note generation takes ~60-120s multi-pass; keep polling timeouts generous. The 'Generating' badge on note cards is rendered in uppercase CSS ('GENERATING') — visually confirmed via screenshot.
